data.name: Shriram
data.short_meaning: God of wealth, prosperity, and victory
data.long_meaning: Shri means 'wealth, prosperity' and Ram means 'God'. Shriram is a name of Vishnu, the preserver deity in Hinduism, who is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and victory in one's life.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the divine presence of God in one's life, bringing wealth, prosperity, and victory.
data.numerology_meaning: Shriram is a name that resonates with the energies of the number 6, which represents harmony, love, and service.

in_sanskrit.name: श्रीराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: श्री (shri) - wealth, prosperity, Rama - a name of Vishnu, राम (rama) - radiant, pleasing

in_hindi.name: श्रीराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्री (shree) - साधु, सर्वविघ्न हर (sadhu, sarvavighn har) - the remover of all obstacles, राम (rama) - सुन्दर (sundar) - beautiful, प्रकाश (prakash) - radiant

in_tamil.name: ஶ்ரீராம்
in_tamil.meaning: ஶ்ரீ (shree) - ஆகாத்தில் ஆவிர்க்கும் ஆருவன் (aakaththil aavirungam aaruvan) - the one who dwells in the hearts of all, ராம் (rama) - புரியாள் (puriyal) - the one who protects

in_telugu.name: శ్రీరామ్
in_telugu.meaning: శ్రీ (shri) - శశ్వత (shashwat) - eternal, రామ్ (rama) - రద్దు (raddhu) - pleasing

in_marathi.name: Shriram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth, prosperity, and victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shriram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shri means 'wealth, prosperity' and Ram means 'God'. Shriram is a name of Vishnu, the preserver deity in Hinduism, who is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and victory in one's life.

in_bengali.name: Shriram
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of wealth, prosperity, and victory

data.cultural_impact: Shriram is a revered name in Hindu culture, particularly in India, and is associated with victory, strength, and success. This name is often used in various forms of art, literature, and media, as well as in religious and devotional practices. Perhaps the most famous manifestation of Shriram is in the epic ramayana, where Lord Rama, an avatar of Vishnu, embodies the ideals of dharma (righteousness), artha (material wealth), kama (desire), and moksha (liberation).
data.spiritual_significance: Shriram is a name of Vishnu, the deity of preservation and protection in Hinduism. By invoking Shriram's name, one seeks to call upon his divine blessings for prosperity, victory, and success in all areas of life. Additionally, Lord Ram's life story exemplifies the importance of dharma, or following one's duty and moral principles, in aligning with the divine will and achieving spiritual growth. Thus, Shriram holds not only material wealth and success, but also a deeper sense of spiritual meaning and connection to the divine.

historical_references.reference: Shri Ram is a revered name in Hinduism, synonymous with Lord Rama, who is considered an avatar of the God Vishnu. He is the central figure of the Indian epic Ramayana, which is believed to have been written between 500 BCE and 400 CE.

Shri Ram is also known as Maryada Purushottam or the ideal man, showcasing perfect dharma, righteousness, and moral integrity. He is highly revered in Hindu society, and his life story is an inspiration for millions.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Shriram continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
